changes.title: Parse fixed-point filters from the exact typed decimal
changes.text: Decimal filters no longer pass through binary floating point. Values such as 1.005 hundredths now map to raw 101, exact large in-range decimals retain every typed digit, Java's prior half-step direction is preserved, and out-of-range results remain invalid. Stored history, query math and displayed values are unchanged.

changes.title: Retain UIMSD boundary coverage added after TEST277
changes.text: The full core suite now includes exact decimal/long boundaries plus retained report model, result-table, catalog, boss classification, filter-operator and topic-search contracts.

changes.title: Carry the complete reviewed TEST277-to-TEST278 history
changes.text: Every meaningful path since the immediate previous compiled TEST277 is retained, including the changed build-history ledger and request itself. TEST277 remains the rollback candidate and TEST262 remains the latest owner publication.
